variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: HS256 key that signs ANON_KEY and SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: ANON_KEY
variables.description: Public client API key — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET. View in supabase.com/docs/guides/self-hosting#api-keys

variables.name: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.description: Server-side key with full access. JWT signed by JWT_SECRET.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for any admin dashboard access (if Studio were included).

variables.name: GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST
variables.description: SMTP host for email sending (empty for no email).

variables.name: GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM
variables.description: Auto-confirm user emails on signup (dev mode).

variables.name: GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST
variables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed redirect URIs.
